## Overview

- Retry the unified MarkdStage release after refreshing npm Trusted Publishing configuration.
- Keep the Canvas Extension, Agent Skills, CLI, and Desktop on the unified 3.7.0 release.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible for existing Markdown decks. No migration is required.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v3.7.0`. |
